ideology.title: Parties and ideologies
ideology.definitionsHint: Pick a ROOT or a sub-ideology; below is the same editor as in the ideology workbench.
ideology.none: There is no ideology to edit.
ideology.workbenchNote: Creating, deleting and checking what references an ideology stay in the ideology workbench.

problem.supportTotal: Support has to add up to 100 (it is {total} now)
problem.lastElectionDate: Write the last election’s date like 1933.3.5
problem.frequency: The election interval has to be a whole number of months, 0 or more
problem.rulingZero: The ruling party’s support cannot be 0
problem.idRequired: Enter an id, for example technocracy
problem.idInvalid: The id may only use lowercase letters, digits and underscores, and cannot start with a digit
problem.rootTakeover: This project is built on a base mod and keeps its ideology groups; a new group cannot be created here
problem.sourceLock: This ideology comes from the base mod; import it and lock its source before creating a sub-ideology under it

field.perStateDays: Extra days for each further state
field.stateLimit: Most states that can be chosen

warGoal.formula: Days to justify = base + per state × states chosen; each day costs 0.2 political power (NDiplomacy.BASE_GENERATE_WARGOAL_DAILY_PP).
warGoal.note: Saving takes the whole file this war goal is in into the project.

autonomy.name: Name (the level name the screens show)
autonomy.minFreedom: Minimum freedom (0 to 1; a subject moves up or down one level in this order)
autonomy.manpower: Share of the subject’s manpower its overlord gets (0 to 1)
autonomy.rule: Rules (rule: what the subject may do)
autonomy.scriptNote: Write rules and modifiers as game script; leave one empty to remove it.
autonomy.problem: The name cannot be empty, numbers must be between 0 and 1, and minimum freedom cannot be empty
autonomy.note: Saving takes the whole file this level is in into the project and changes only its block; a level made in the autonomy level workbench changes that row. The name is saved as the localisation of the level’s id, so every screen changes with it.

newCountry.heading: Country
newCountry.summary: Create a country and give it states
newCountry.giveTitle: Give {tag} states (makes it the owner and adds its core)
newCountry.searchPlaceholder: State name, number or current owner (e.g. GER)
newCountry.give: Give {count, plural, one {# state} other {# states}} to {tag}
newCountry.gave: Gave {count, plural, one {# state} other {# states}} to {tag}
newCountry.gaveHint: It can now be picked from the minor country list on the country selection screen.
newCountry.hint: Once it is created, give it states here; the game only lists countries that own states. You can also add a new piece of land for it in “World Map”.
newCountry.gaveLog: {tag} gets {count, plural, one {# state} other {# states}}

province.noStateTitle: This place is not in any state
province.stateKind: STATE_{id} · Owner {owner} · {count, plural, one {# province} other {# provinces}}
province.noRegionTitle: This place is not in any strategic region
province.regionKind: STRATEGICREGION_{id} · {count, plural, one {# province} other {# provinces}}
province.landNoState: Not in any state. Switch to “Province” to edit this block itself.
province.waterNoState: Seas and lakes are not in any state. Switch to “Province” to edit this block itself.
province.noRegion: This block is not in any strategic region.
province.openWorldMap: Open in the World Map workbench ↗

state.missing: Neither the base game nor the project has state {id}; there is nothing to edit here.
state.adopting: Pulling this state into the project… (it is not written into the exported mod unless you change it)
state.loading: Loading the state from the project…

problem.self: A country cannot do this with itself
problem.subjectAutonomy: Each subject needs an autonomy type
problem.relationType: Each treaty needs a treaty type

problem.nameRequired: The country name cannot be empty
problem.adjectiveRequired: The adjective cannot be empty (for example German)
problem.capitalRequired: The capital must be a state number
